{{Quote|There's a group of bandits led by Trae Nedgarr, that call themselves the Nedgarr bandits. It's not exactly the most clever of names. Anyway, they damage my crops and steal my grain.|[[Pol Handerin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />}}
'''Trae Nedgarr''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he created and took the leadership of the [[Nedgarr Bandits]], named after himself. The criminals operated out of their [[Nedgarr Bandits hideout|hideout]] on the outskirts of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. Trae Nedgarr and the Bandits used to vandalize and rob local [[Farm/Legends|farms]], such as [[Pol Handerin]]'s [[Pol Handerin's farm|farm]].<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] dispatched a recruit to deal with the Nedgarr Bandits. The CorSec agent recovered Pol Handerin's stolen grain and killed Trae Nedgarr during the assault of the Nedgarr Bandits Hideout.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trae Nedgarr was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Trae Nedgarr was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:ToOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]", on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 27 is now live!">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=66900&month=022006|text=Publish 27 is now live!}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />

Although his appearance was always obscured by his armor, using an in-game text command revealed him to be a Human male. Targeting Nedgarr identified him as "Trae Nedgarr (the Nedgar Bandits leader)". This identification misspelled Nedgarr Bandits, as it was consistently shown to have two R's rather than one.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />
